reviews.title: Refund Request
reviews.text: As with a lot of subscription apps they make it difficult to find the right place to cancel a subscription. I thought I had already done this, but I just got recharged today. Of course, the terms are that I can’t cancel a subscription renewal. Naturally this leaves a bad taste in the mouth. Hence the one star review.

reviews.title: Slow down your training session
reviews.text: The app need to be improve, so many exercises missing. Setting up a program is super slow.

reviews.title: A Cash Grab with a Predatory Cancellation Process
reviews.text:
Save your money. There are far better workout programs available for free (look up Jeff Nippard) that don’t trap you in a subscription cycle. Freeletics makes it incredibly difficult to unsubscribe. 

Even after I went through the steps to cancel, they auto-renewed my subscription for a second year. When I reached out to customer service to explain the error, they didn't care and flat-out refused a refund. Unless you want to be stuck fighting a constant battle to cancel your plan, avoid this app at all costs.

reviews.title: Poor Favourites & No Equipment Functionality
reviews.text: I tried to create a daily workout routine, with no equipment, to enable me to moderately build upper body strength. I could not find input features to enable this. Once I’d found a programme which seemed to fit the bill I favourited it. However, there does not seem any way to access that saved favourite. Highly frustrating experience.

reviews.title: Insane
reviews.text: Signed up and entered all my details and workout goals. First exercise is 7 reps of 36 dumbbell squats. Ok…so from not having done any exercise to doing 252 dumbbell squats. Not sure that is helpful. I didn’t manage to complete the rest of the session that was scheduled for nearly 2 hours. And 2 days later I can still barely walk 😅😂

reviews.title: Careful
reviews.text: It’s very expensive 140 CHF per year and you get a lot of unwanted mails which you cannot avoid. The “unsubscribe” link in the mails causes a 404 error and doesn’t unsubscribe you from the advertising mails.

reviews.title: Auto renewal without notice
reviews.text:
I just got an email that my annual subscription has been renewed. 

I was under the impression that it was already canceled, as there was nothing under “subscriptions” in my iPhone, and still isn’t.

There was nothing under notification or email about a pending auto renewal, so needless to say I’m unimpressed that money suddenly has been taken out of my bank account.

reviews.title: Groundhog Day
reviews.text:
I’ve been consistently using this app and, unfortunately, it hasn’t lived up to expectations. The workouts feel very repetitive, often cycling through the exact same exercises for multiple rounds — sometimes up to ten — which makes it hard to stay engaged or feel challenged.

Another issue is the lack of balance in the programming. The stretching routines don’t always align with the muscles being worked. I’ve noticed time spent stretching areas that weren’t used, while the muscles that were actually targeted are sometimes overlooked. This makes the recovery portion feel ineffective.

Most importantly, I haven’t seen any meaningful results, including weight loss, despite sticking with the program. The combination of repetitive workouts, mismatched stretching, and lack of progress has made the experience frustrating overall.

I was hoping for a more dynamic, well-rounded fitness program that adapts and delivers results, but this app hasn’t provided that.

reviews.title: Avoid: no respect for their customers.
reviews.text: If you had asked me a week ago I’d have given them 5 stars, I think the app is fantastic and have used it religiously for a couple of years. However last week I forgot to cancel a paid version of the subscription as I had a complimentary one with Revolut so didn’t need two. They charged for a year and have refused to refund. They even acknowledged that their business practices (not sending reminders before renewal) will be illegal when the new legislation comes in later this year - they are aware that they have bad business practices but don’t want to do anything about it until they are forced to. I am so disappointed as it was such a great app but I’d urge people to use literally any other provider considering how poorly they treat their users. See less

reviews.title: DONT SIGN UP
reviews.text: They make it impossible to cancel. Even when you do, they will STILL charge your card a MASSIVE renewal fee. This is a widespread issue with many victims of their “business model”. Stay away.

reviews.title: Get this app for free and still can’t deleting it
reviews.text: Would give zero starts if I could. Warm ups and exercises way too repetitive , constant focus on the same muscle groups every session and cool downs don’t focus on the worked areas. Been constantly updating, providing feedback and still no improvement. As said I don’t pay for this app but I’m still switching to a paid alternative as it’s a complete waste of time - don’t waste yours

reviews.title: Zu teuer für etwas was es bei YouTube besser und gratis gibt!
reviews.text: Ich finde die App zu kompliziert. Es werden viele Geräte dazu empfohlen. Dies war doch eigentlich nicht das Konzept!

reviews.title: Very poor app functionality
reviews.text: It does nothing. Asking nothing on understanding your goals or movements, it just puts some excercises and ask you to share weights. You cannot change excercises. It does not take your muscle goals, weight etc nothing despite connecting to apple health. It cannot create a personalized gym program. Any AI will give you better and more personalized program.

reviews.title: Auto renewed at full price with no reminder- refund refused
reviews.text: Auto renewed at £119.99 after a discounted black Friday deal for £36. There was no reminder email sent whatsoever. When I contacted them for a refund they point-blank refused. Most decent companies these days are sending renewal reminder emails which is clear, honest and ethical. Clearly Freeletics aren’t interested in looking after customers. Buyer beware.

reviews.title: Avoid!!!
reviews.text: The app is poor, the work outs average and the auto renewal the bury and make hard to find is shocking.

reviews.title: Not for disabled ppl or people that just started exercising.
reviews.text: App is excellent for healthy people I must say before anything else, but clearly is for someone that is already fit. I downloaded the app as I have a connective tissue disease and Hashimoto’s, which makes exercising very difficult, but my Doctor told me I need to build some muscle. I came in after a couple years of doing nothing and ask the app for basic training and still I’m not able to keep up with the exercises, they’re still very demanding for my body, I spend more time adapting the actual workouts and customising  them than doing anything, and even so I can’t finish them most of the time, I’m 130 lbs so is not like by body weight is dragging me, I can imagine if some one heavier tried this app.

reviews.title: Awful Customer Service
reviews.text: Automatically took subscription payment even though I turned off auto renewal. Contacted customer support same day of the payment to ask for a refund and cancel the order (before they had even issued a confirmation email of renewal) - and was told this isn’t possible and no refunds are given for renewals. Asked for proof that auto renewal was on, couldn’t provide it and said they would no longer respond to my query about this and closed the case.

reviews.title: Paid for Nutrition Coach — Feature Unavailable and No Customer Support
reviews.text:
I subscribed to the “Training & Nutrition Coach” plan, but there is no Nutrition section in the main Freeletics app, and their separate Nutrition app does not work at all.

I contacted customer support twice by email and also reached out via Instagram, but I have never received any response.

I paid for a feature that cannot be used, and the customer service is completely nonexistent.

This is very disappointing and unacceptable for a paid subscription.

reviews.title: Restore standalone Apple Watch feature
reviews.text: Please restore the standalone Apple Watch feature, and I’ll give you five stars.

reviews.title: Good app, but sharks when it comes to billing
reviews.text: I love this app and it served me well over the last few years. However, I decided to cancel my subscription and did so inside the app months ago. There were no reminders of upcoming subscription renewals, no warnings that credit cards would be charged. When my subscription was renewed, I wrote to Freeletics immediately stating this is a mistake, but their customer service told me 1. No refunds and 2. They would not reply to any more enquiries from me on this topic. terrible and unhelpful customer service, and terrible service for a customer who has been paying for 3-4 years.
